facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past Cyan Bar & Sunset Dining. Their loss. This spot on Tran Hung Dao sits away from the main strip, pulls a 4.7-star rating from people who actually found it, and serves up front-row sunset views without the inflated beachclub prices. Arrive before golden hour. Grab a seat facing west. That's the whole plan. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
